# Regression Safety Checklist: SPEC-009C4 - Owner Merge Gate and Done Reconciliation

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009C4 requirements protect existing GitHub sync, ready-for-owner, task-chain, evidence, and future-spec boundaries from regressions.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Existing Behavior Compatibility

- [ ] CHK001 Are compatibility requirements explicit that existing non-pilot GitHub sync behavior remains unchanged except for proven exact-PR reconciliation gaps? [Regression Safety, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements clear that existing PR-producing tasks outside the C4 pilot continue to use the established `ready_for_owner` behavior unless exact merged-PR evidence satisfies the linked task gate? [Regression Safety, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the plan identify the existing `pullFromGitHub(project, workspaceId)` path as the only production reconciliation path, avoiding a new API, webhook, poller, or scheduler path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK004 Are success criteria measurable enough to detect regressions where closed issues, unrelated merged PRs, or local-only status changes complete a task? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are label/status projection requirements specific enough to catch stale `ready_for_owner` labels after a valid transition to `done`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-005]

## Side-Effect Containment

- [ ] CHK006 Are duplicate-sync idempotency requirements explicit for terminal completion, task-chain advancement, owner-action notifications, reconciliation-required notifications, terminal activities, and cleanup work? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the plan require `advanceTaskChain` only after verified `github_pr_merged` evidence, preserving existing successor side-effect parity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Summary, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK008 Are failed GitHub sync requirements clear that transport, authentication, permission, rate-limit, timeout, and upstream API failures produce failed-sync evidence without terminal side effects? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK009 Are reconciliation-required evidence requirements distinguishable from failed-sync evidence and successful terminal evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-019, Contract §Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK010 Can bounded evidence requirements be objectively evaluated without requiring a new terminal-done notification type? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, Spec Clarifications §Session 3]

- [ ] CHK011 Are out-of-scope boundaries explicit for SPEC-009D/E packet work, SPEC-013A/A1/B/C run-state and poller work, and SPEC-014A-D sandbox/adapter work? [Scope Boundary, Spec §FR-017, Spec Clarifications §Session 4]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec forbid claim/run state tables, sandbox lifecycle, harness adapters, review packet persistence, lifecycle snapshot APIs, evidence dashboards, and packet UI from entering C4? [Regression Safety, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-007]

## Evidence And UAT Boundaries

- [ ] CHK015 Are live smoke requirements explicit that C4 must use a fresh synthetic pilot PR and must not reuse closed/unmerged SPEC-009C3 PR #49? [Regression Safety, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Are fixture and mocked PR evidence requirements clearly limited to automated tests and excluded from live API, UI, future poller, and smoke proof paths? [Trust Boundary, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Test Fixture Boundary]
- [ ] CHK017 Are SPEC-009D handoff requirements limited to existing task, activity, notification, label, artifact, quality-review, sync, and smoke-checklist evidence sources? [Scope Boundary, Spec §FR-012, Spec Clarifications §Session 4]
- [ ] CHK018 Are cleanup failure documentation requirements separated from merge/sync reconciliation truth so cleanup debt cannot hide or change terminal task state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Contract §Live UAT Cleanup Failure]
